adjudication.rationale: The new `addGuestsHandler` fetches the booking and proceeds to update attendees, call `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`, and send ICS emails without any guard on booking state (no check like `booking.status` / `booking.cancelledAt` etc. appears in the diff). Separately, the new email templates hardcode ICS `status: "CONFIRMED"` in both `packages/emails/templates/attendee-add-guests-email.ts` and `packages/emails/templates/organizer-add-guests-email.ts`. While the finding’s claim about a "likely-deleted event" isn’t verifiable from the diff, the absence of a booking-status gate combined with always-CONFIRMED ICS is a concrete edge-case concern introduced by this change.
